definitions: A fictional location, specifically a castle or a region, often featured in Scottish ballads and folklore, most notably in the ballad 'The Twa Sisters' (also known as 'Binnorie' or 'The Cruel Sister'). It is typically associated with a tragic tale of two sisters, one of whom drowns the other.
examples: The sad tale of the two sisters of Binnorie is a classic.
Many versions of the ballad mention the castle of Binnorie.
The ancient stones of Binnorie held a dark secret.
